main_switch2.description: Studio V2 build 37. Everything from build 36, plus one change: when a heat-up stalls below your temperature and the rescue push kicks in, the push now stops 5 F under your temperature instead of 3 F, so it overshoots less. If a heat-up does not stall, build 37 heats the same as build 36. No full-power start. The safety ceilings are unchanged. Tested in emulation; your first dabs on it are its first real runs. If anything feels off, install build 36 from this list.

main_switch2_build31.description: Studio V2 build 31. Everything from build 30, plus: when you start from a cold insert (160 °F or less), the device holds your first temperature with its own heater law until the buzz, so the buzz lands closer to your first point. The heat-up itself ramps up exactly as before. A slow heat-up can now buzz as late as 59 s instead of 52 s rather than stopping short. Warm starts and presets run exactly as build 30. Tested in emulation; your first dabs on it are its first real runs.

main_switch2_build30.description: Studio V2 build 30. Everything from build 29, plus: while the insert is well above a falling line, the heater switches fully off instead of half on, so steep drops run closer to your line. Tested in emulation; your first dabs on it are its first real runs.

main_switchgo.description: Studio V2 Go build 36. Everything from Go build 35, plus Fast Descent: a custom curve can fall up to 30 F per second instead of the stock 3 F per second. Rises stay at most 10 F per second, and every point stays between 250 and 650 F and within 90 s. The insert only cools as fast as it loses heat, so a steep drawn fall is followed as closely as the insert allows. Tested in emulation; your first dabs on it are its first real runs. If anything behaves oddly, install Go build 35 or Go build 2 from this list. Your Go keeps reporting SWG-260929 after the install.

main_switchgo_build35.description: Studio V2 Go build 35 (Switch Go Beta 1). Everything from Go build 2, plus: the Go buzzes once two readings in a row sit within about 1 F of your temperature instead of about 24 F short while still climbing, and every heat-up buzzes by 59 s at the latest. At temperature the Go shows the Heated colour you picked, set by the device itself. Hill now rises and comes back as drawn, every mode stays between 250 and 650 F, and the heater no longer stores up extra push during a long heat-up. Tested in emulation; your first dabs on it are its first real runs. If a heat-up behaves oddly, install Go build 2 from this list. Your Go keeps reporting SWG-260929 after the install.

main_switchgo_build2.description: Studio V2 Go build 2. Everything from Go build 1 (heat target rounded to the nearest whole degree, top heat capped at 650 F, half the extra heating push let go at ready), plus: the Go won't start a heat under 6 % battery, and it tells this app which Studio features it runs, so the app plans every curve on the right heat law. Your Go keeps reporting SWG-260929 after the install.

main_switchgo_build1.description: Studio V2 Go build 1. The heat target rounds to the nearest whole degree instead of down, the top heat is capped at 650 F, and when the device says ready the heater lets go of half the extra push it built up while heating. Your Go keeps reporting SWG-260929 after the install; this app remembers that it installed Studio.

main_switch2_build29.description: Studio V2 build 29. With Fast Descent on, the device now follows your line only on steep drops, and one misread sensor reading cannot set it off. Holds get stronger heat, so the insert stays on your curve. Everything from builds 27 and 28 stays: Vapor Profiles on the device, the heat target rounded to the nearest whole degree, and power-off from the button.

main_switch2_build32.description: Studio V2 build 32. Everything from build 31, plus: on a cold insert (160 °F or less) the device now holds your first temperature itself on presets AND custom curves, with no setting to turn on, so the heat-up no longer stalls 15-20 °F short and creeps in. The heater goes to full power from the first second instead of a 3.6 s ramp. Warm starts run as build 31. A flat preset keeps holding on its temperature after the buzz. Tested in emulation; your first dabs on it are its first real runs. If a heat-up stops in its first second, install build 31 from this list.

main_switch2_build33.description: Studio V2 build 33. Build 32 without the full-power start: the heater ramps up like build 31 again, which should stop the three white flashes at the start of a heat-up. Everything else from build 32 stays: on a cold insert the device holds your first temperature itself on presets and custom curves, and a flat preset keeps holding after the buzz. Tested in emulation; your first dab is its first real run.

main_switch2_build35.description: Studio V2 build 35. Everything from build 33, plus: the device's heater law now also runs on warm heat-ups, so a warm start buzzes nearer your temperature; a heat-up that stalls short of your temperature gets a small push to finish; and after the buzz the heater idles while your custom curve falls and the reading is at or above the line. No full-power start. The safety ceilings are unchanged. Tested in emulation and replayed against your saved profiles and curves; your first dabs on it are its first real runs. If anything feels off, install build 33 from this list.

main_switch2_build36.description: Studio V2 build 36. Everything from build 35, plus one change: if the device's first temperature reading after you press arrives late, the heater law now still turns on for that heat-up. On build 35 a late first reading left the law off, so the ready buzz landed under your temperature and the heat swung after it. If the first reading is on time, build 36 heats the same as build 35. No full-power start. The safety ceilings are unchanged. Tested in emulation and replayed against your saved profiles and curves; your first dabs on it are its first real runs. If anything feels off, install build 35 from this list.
